$comment: Provider pack: Z.AI web-search-prime MCP server. Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack zai. NOTE: the base opencode.json has no zai-web-search-prime* key in the tools map (the other zai-* servers default to enabled:true), so this pack ADDS the tools key rather than flipping an existing one. Requires ZAI_API_KEY.
